preprocessing.gene_order: training CSV order; evaluation aligned by gene name

rationale: Small dataset and sparse overdispersed counts favor a compact count-likelihood baseline with regularized latent representation. Fixed training budget; no evaluation-driven selection.

rejected_alternatives.GAN: Instability and mode-collapse risk with small n; continuous output/count conversion less appropriate.
rejected_alternatives.flow: Continuous density and heuristic count conversion less aligned with raw counts.
rejected_alternatives.diffusion: Higher training/sampling cost and continuous/count conversion; no demonstrated need over count VAE.

evaluation_plan: Finite nonnegative integer counts with original gene order
Approximate real library sizes, sparsity, detection and expression
Diversity comparable to real data; assess nearest-neighbor distances
Use evaluator real-data baselines; do not claim cell-type fidelity or downstream utility.
follow_up_policy: Only a targeted follow-up if numerical/training failure or clearly unresolved training trend warrants it; do not tune repeatedly on evaluation data.
